name: 087.1 — three endings take the vocabulary's own word
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 087.1: rule:release() gives a widget's own layer back and the widget resolves to the client's own again, sheet:release() drops the sheet, hafen.asset():remove(a) frees a loaded image and the count falls by one, rule:remove() / sheet:drop() / img:dispose() each raise naming their replacement, and the collection refuses a path, a face that was never a file and a map drawing it does not hold.
